experiences.description: Building AI tools to help marketers scale.

Bidgely’s AI based analytics platform enables utilities to achieve energy efficiency, grid management and customer satisfaction goals.
•	Planned and managed need-finding activities for new product features; did user shadowing, prototyped product concepts, conducted user and stakeholder interviews, attended utility conferences and assisted with sales calls.
•	Managed partnership approval processes to integrate our solution with other call center tools like CIS/CRMs and telephony services.
•	Planned sprints with product, design and engineering teams to build and test product features.

•Identified and secured resources for the project; managed cross-functional relationships with engineering, warehouse management, supply chain, operations, production maintenance, and third-party contractors.
•Successfully analyzed problems and implemented cross-functional solutions that reduced rejection rate in a complex inventory storage system by 44%.

Out-There-Media’s mobile advertising platform runs SMS based ad campaigns for large multinational companies.
•	Led a team that designed, prototyped and validated UI/UX flow of a mobile advertising platform to be used by small businesses. 
•	Formulated product requirements, designed app flow, built a mock-up mobile app and interviewed 6 users to validate the prototype.

• Planned and executed a new product research project
• Managed a team that identified two new product need areas through competitive landscaping, need finding survey, 3 field observation visits, 14 user interviews, and an iterative landing page test to validate the value propositions.

• Planned and managed sales sprints of five membered team; set-up sales processes and sales metrics
• Handled 53 hospitals of which made repeat in-person sales visits at 22 and pitched product to 31 hospitals over phone.
• Interviewed stakeholders and generated insights on ways to increase sales. Proposed three and piloted two concepts.
• Set-up and managed HubSpot CRM and metrics for sales team. 
• Managed end-to-end activities and listed Bempu Bracelet on Amazon.
• Handled Customer Care calls and made customer visits to diagnose and resolve customer complaints

• Built the company from ground up; performed user and market research; iteratively developed business models and course structure based on market feedback; hired a team member; formulated processes for day-to-day operations.
• Successfully conducted a market pilot with 7 paying customers and generated revenue of INR 34.5K

• Project Leader Embrace Nest Aqua- owned initial research, product development and manufacturing
 • Led a 7 member cross functional team and managed end-to-end product development, including compiling product requirements and driving consensus on product features, managing budget, design, regulatory compliance, liaising with external consultants,  sourcing and setting up a production line.

• Project Manager of the engineering team- formulated timelines and resourcing of the engineering projects and facilitate cross departmental co-ordination for on-time delivery of projects 
• Conducted user research with doctors and village mothers to test acceptability of hot water based infant warmers and to do need-finding for new product development.

• Lead design engineer and co-inventor (US Patent US20150066119 A1) for company’s flagship product, the Embrace Care, World’s first infant warmer that works without electricity and commercialised for use by rural mothers
• Managed design and testing of mechanical parts in Embrace Care and Embrace Nest Aqua from ideation to market.
• Liaised with over 15 manufacturing vendors to bring the design from prototype to mass-manufacturability.
• Troubleshot units and provided engineering support during clinical trials; designed and conducted engineering experiments
• Designed an innovative cash lifting mechanism for an ATM
